book_pip_moon_1.speaker: seraphina
book_pip_moon_1.spoken: Pip the dog zoomed up to the moon!

book_pip_moon_2.speaker: seraphina
book_pip_moon_2.spoken: On the moon Pip met a baby dragon!

book_pip_moon_3.speaker: seraphina
book_pip_moon_3.spoken: The dragon sneezed sparkles all over Pip!

book_pip_moon_4.speaker: seraphina
book_pip_moon_4.spoken: Now Pip and the dragon are best friends!

dad_bunny_coin.speaker: dad
dad_bunny_coin.spoken: The bunnies want you to have this shiny gold coin!

dad_quest_carrots.speaker: dad
dad_quest_carrots.spoken: Bunnies love carrots, find three in the woods.

dad_quest_chop.speaker: dad
dad_quest_chop.spoken: Chop the little trees with your axe!

dad_quest_lure.speaker: dad
dad_quest_lure.spoken: Give a bunny a carrot and walk it home to me!

dad_quest_offer.speaker: dad
dad_quest_offer.spoken: Three little bunnies are stuck in the woods!

dad_quest_pen.speaker: dad
dad_quest_pen.spoken: Little trees are all around the bunnies, find them in the woods.

dad_shed.speaker: dad
dad_shed.spoken: I keep all my tools in this shed.

morgana_book_best.speaker: morgana
morgana_book_best.spoken: That was the best story ever, thank you Seraphina.

morgana_book_moon.speaker: morgana
morgana_book_moon.spoken: All the way to the moon!

morgana_story_book.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_book.spoken: There is a storybook on the bookshelf!

morgana_story_coin.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_coin.spoken: Here is a shiny gold coin for the best reader!

morgana_story_come.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_come.spoken: Come and sit on the rug with me!

morgana_story_hug.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_hug.spoken: Big hug, I love story time.

morgana_story_offer.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_offer.spoken: Will you read me a story?

morgana_story_read.speaker: morgana
morgana_story_read.spoken: Press the green button to open the book!

seraphina_apple.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_apple.spoken: I want to pick an apple!

seraphina_bed.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_bed.spoken: My cozy bed, time to sleep!

seraphina_book.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_book.spoken: I want to read a book!

seraphina_goodnight.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_goodnight.spoken: Goodnight world, see you in the morning.

seraphina_morning.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_morning.spoken: Good morning, a brand new day!

seraphina_one_bunny.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_one_bunny.spoken: One bunny at a time, silly!

seraphina_recap_bunnies.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_bunnies.spoken: I took three little bunnies home to their den.

seraphina_recap_errand.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_errand.spoken: I helped my friend look for magic stones.

seraphina_recap_faeries.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_faeries.spoken: We called real faeries out of the fire.

seraphina_recap_stones.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_stones.spoken: I cracked a magic stone right open.

seraphina_recap_story.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_story.spoken: I read my little sister a whole story.

seraphina_recap_trees.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_recap_trees.spoken: I chopped a whole tree down with my axe.

seraphina_secret.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_secret.spoken: I need your help making sure Dad never finds this!

seraphina_wardrobe.speaker: seraphina
seraphina_wardrobe.spoken: My wardrobe, full of pretty clothes!

sneak_cave_greet.speaker: sneak
sneak_cave_greet.spoken: You made it, stand by the fire.

sneak_coin.speaker: sneak
sneak_coin.spoken: This shiny gold coin is for you!

sneak_faeries.speaker: sneak
sneak_faeries.spoken: My spell book says faeries are real, I'm going to prove it!

sneak_quest_cave.speaker: sneak
sneak_quest_cave.spoken: We have them all, meet me at the Secret Cave.

sneak_quest_crack.speaker: sneak
sneak_quest_crack.spoken: Crack the stones with your hammer.

sneak_quest_hammer.speaker: sneak
sneak_quest_hammer.spoken: I saw a hammer near the well!

sneak_quest_offer.speaker: sneak
sneak_quest_offer.spoken: My spell book has a faerie spell, we need three magic stones.

sneak_quest_stones.speaker: sneak
sneak_quest_stones.spoken: A ruby, a sapphire, and a malachite, you'll need a hammer to crack them.

sneak_secrets.speaker: sneak
sneak_secrets.spoken: Shhh, this book is full of secrets.

sneak_thanks.speaker: sneak
sneak_thanks.spoken: We did it, thank you Seraphina.
